music.prompt: Light, upbeat and optimistic tech explainer music at exactly 100 BPM: plucky synths, soft claps, a warm bouncing bass, gentle marimba and bright bell accents; friendly, modern and steady, made to sit under a narrator. No vocals, no breaks, no long silences, no big final hit. A steady, feel-good groove from the first second with small lifts every eight bars, slightly brighter from about 28 seconds, and a soft, clean ending in the last 4 seconds.
